name: montecarlo
description: Seeded Monte Carlo simulation, reproducible with seed 7 stated in every reply: portfolio paths (Box-Muller returns, P5/median/P95, chance of loss), dice-sum distributions validated against the analytical mode and mean, and project-finish estimates with the model's limits declared (independent tasks, normal returns).
route: monte carlo: portfolio 1000000, yearly return 8% +/- 15%, 20 years, simulate 10000 rolls of 2 dice, monte carlo project finish: 5 tasks, each 5 days +/- 2
